what: fuzz/targets/syntax_parse.rs parses the text twice in Edition::CURRENT: it parses with SourceFile::parse (needed for its own checks) and then calls syntax::fuzz::check_parser(&text), which parses again only to run the private check_file_invariants (validation::validate_block_structure). Please add `pub fn check_parse(file: &Parse<SourceFile>)` (= check_file_invariants, public) in crates/syntax/src/fuzz.rs, keeping check_parser. Then syntax_parse calls check_parse(&parse) on the parse it has, saving one parse in a quarter of its runs (one edition of four), about 10% of the run. Tell speed-sol2-proof-fuzz (or whoever owns fuzz/) when it lands; fuzz/ changes the call.
